# Recast

> Recast is an open-source, self-hosted browser toolbench for private file conversion and everyday web utilities.

Recast processes uploaded files on the operator's own server. It includes image, audio, video, archive and PDF conversion, plus website screenshots, a media downloader, tokenizer, DNS lookup, IP inspector, speed test, pastebin and currency conversion.

## Main tools

- [Universal converter](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/): Convert mixed files with per-file output format and quality controls.
- [Image converter](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/images): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, HEIC and SVG; supports image-to-PDF and GIF-to-video workflows.
- [Video converter](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/video): Convert MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, AVI, FLV, MPEG, 3GP and MPEG-TS; create GIFs or extract audio.
- [Audio converter](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/audio): Convert MP3, WAV, OGG, Opus, FLAC, AAC, M4A, AIFF, WMA and AC-3.
- [PDF tools](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/pdf): Merge and split PDFs or convert between PDFs and images.
- [Website screenshot](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/screenshot): Capture web pages as PNG or JPEG with viewport, delay, full-page, color-scheme and scale controls.
- [Tokenizer](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/tokenizer): Count and inspect tokens for major language-model families in the browser.
- [Network tools](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/dig): DNS lookup, IP inspection and a browser-to-server speed test.
- [Pastebin](https://recast.serhiifotex.dev/paste): Create private or link-accessible text pastes.
